broken.what: Question 1 is a topic-test question with no answer box. Step 1 shows the answer ('All three sides are equal (SSS)…') and the student only taps Next. Nothing is tested, and it is marked 'no marks' even though it counts as one of the 10 questions.

Question 4 asks 'Which congruence condition applies?' but Step 1 shows the answer 'SAS congruence' straight away. Both steps are statements with no input, so the student cannot answer and the app records nothing.
In a topic test, the method and working are given as unanswerable statements. Q3 Step 1 gives the tan rearrangement and Q5 Step 1 gives u − v = (5, 4). Only the final calculator step is tested.

After the student leaves mid-test, the home page says 'Pick up where you left off' but has no button or card to resume the test. The student has to find the topic again to see 'Carry on your topic test (question 5 of 10)'.
broken.step: Student taps Home and leaves the test / after-leaving

broken.what: The resumed test page has no 'question 5 of 10' label and no progress dots, so the student cannot see where they are in the test.
broken.step: Student comes back to the topic / after-coming-back

looks_wrong.what: The test header line 'Topic test · question N of 10' is half hidden under the sticky top nav, so the text is clipped at the top.
The encouragement message in the test header is cut off under the nav: only 'Good — using hints is smart, not weak.' is partly visible on laptop, and only 'is smart, not weak.' shows on phone.
The feedback line is clipped to just 'going.' under the top nav.
The home page says 'Pick up where you left off — you were doing well.' but no resume card is shown, and History still says 'No sessions yet'.
The resumed test has no question counter or progress dots at the top.

would_quit.quote: Find |u − v| = |(5, 4)| = √(5² + 4²). Calculate it to 2 d.p.
would_quit.why: The test never says whether a calculator is allowed (the warm-up said no calculator), there are two free 'no marks' questions so it feels pointless, and the student gave up here.

fixes.change: Add an answer input, e.g. a choice of SSS/SAS/ASA/RHS. Show the explanation statement only after the student answers, and give the question at least 1 mark.
In test mode, hide working statements such as the tan rearrangement and u − v = (5, 4). Either turn them into answerable steps or move them behind 'I need a hint'.
Add top padding equal to the nav height so 'Topic test · question N of 10' and the feedback text sit fully below the nav. Keep this header visible on the resumed test page.

fixes.target: Home page when a test is in progress
fixes.change: Show a highlighted card 'Carry on your Geometry & Measures test (question 5 of 10) →' that links straight to the saved question.

fixes.target: Topic test intro and question header
fixes.change: State 'Calculator allowed' on calculator questions such as Q3 and Q5, so it does not clash with the warm-up's 'no calculator' message.

checks.what: coming back resumes the same test question
